reuse.why: Extends the existing shared pre-link guard (assertBankAccountNotLinked) that all six provider link functions already call, instead of adding checks per provider.

duplication.why: No copied logic; the guard issues its own small SELECT for the upgrading account that each link function fetches again right after, a minor redundant lookup.

placement.why: The precondition sits in the server accounts module's link guard, next to the existing already-linked rule.

scope.why: Only the guard, its rename at the six call sites, tests and a release note.

maintainability.why: One guard named for what it now checks, used by every provider path; a new provider gets the rule by calling it.

one_place.where: assertBankAccountCanBeLinked in packages/loot-core/src/server/accounts/app.ts, called by all six link*Account functions
